md: - **Policy mix:** inflation control may need **monetary + fiscal + exchange-rate** policies with supply management; monetary policy alone cannot fix **supply-side** inflation
- **NSS 2011-12:** agriculture's share of the workforce about **48.9%** (Census 2001: 58.2%); still the **largest employer**
- **28th QES (2015):** **textiles and apparel** contributed most to job growth (Labour Bureau)
- **Online Labour Index** (Oxford Internet Institute): **India** is the largest supplier of online freelance labour, mainly software and tech work
- **PMRY delivery:** implemented through **District Industries Centres (DICs)** with bank loans to educated unemployed youth
- **Origin:** UPA's **National Common Minimum Programme (2004)** promised 100 days of work a year, which led to NREGA 2005

- **National floor wage:** **Anoop Satpathy Committee (2019)** recommended a national minimum wage of **₹375/day**
- **Occupier (Factories Act 1948, Sec 2(n)):** person with **ultimate control** over a factory; in a company a **director** must be named

- **ESI wage ceiling:** **₹21,000/month** (from 2017); ESIC gives health and cash benefits to insured workers
- **EPF interest rate 2016-17:** **8.65%**, recommended by EPFO's **Central Board of Trustees**, ratified by Finance Ministry; ⚠ APPSC key (2017) gave 8.75%
- **National Social Security Number (2004):** Labour Ministry card via **EPFO**, unchanged on job change; forerunner of the **UAN (2014)**
- **World Poverty Clock** (World Data Lab): tracks in **real time** the number of people below the World Bank's extreme poverty line
- **VAMBAY** (Valmiki Ambedkar Awas Yojana, **Dec 2001**): housing for **urban BPL slum dwellers**; merged into JNNURM's **BSUP**; rural counterpart **Indira Awaas Yojana**
- **Mission Indradhanush** (**Dec 2014**): **full immunisation** of children under two and pregnant women against vaccine-preventable diseases
- **Milestone:** reserves crossed **USD 100 bn** in **Dec 2003**; India about **6th** largest holder in 2004
- **Bloc vs country:** in 2018 the **EU as a bloc** took the most Indian exports; **USA** is the top **single country**
- **Gold Card Scheme** (RBI, EXIM Policy 2003-04): quicker, cheaper credit with 3-year in-principle limits for **creditworthy exporters**
- **SWIFT:** **Belgium**-based cooperative **messaging** network (1973); sends payment instructions, does **not** move funds or impose sanctions
- **FPI → FDI reclassification** (RBI framework, Nov 2024): FPI holding above **10%** of a listed company can be reclassified as **FDI**
